Matheus Cunha.

History in the making 🤌

Covering every inch 🏃

See which Premier League players have covered the most distance so far this season 👉 https://premierleague.app.link/e/Yd0FSF40L7b

Phil 💬 (On his start to the season) Personally, I think it's gone really well. The red card against United was unfortunate, but I came back really good, fresh-minded and sharp. I’ve been involved in a lot of goals so I've been really happy with my own performance.

I took some family time and went on holiday. It was a long time without football, which felt strange. It gave me time to work on things I needed to. And I came back feeling fresh.

Enzo 💬 It's not just about Phil [Foden]. The same thing, in and out of the team for Rayan [Cherki] or Iliman [Ndiaye]. Because we have so many games and many players. It's not a short run. It's not a sprint, it's a marathon. We have to think about 65 games and it's important to think about winning games but it's also important to think about February and March and to have all of them available and fit.

Enzo 💬 I see Phil [Foden] day by day getting better and better, for sure. He's going to give us many things this season. We are in all competitions and we have 20 senior players, all of them very good so, there's competition between them. I'm very happy with the way Phil is working every day.
